title: Using PVG tileset s with RMMZ?

posts.author: Mixxer5
posts.body: I've bought RPG Maker MZ - Medieval: Town & Country and have ton of problems to get it working. Character sprites are too large, some tilesets work, some don't appear at all (it's like they're not present at all- tiles placed undearneth are visible instead). From what I've gathered, it was created for RMMV and relies heavily on Q plugins to work- except it seems like those aren't available for MZ. Is there any other way to get it working?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
If you specify which plugins it's supposed to interact with, people might be able to help you find an MZ equivalent.
Plugins can't change the editor, however - so formatting the images for characters and tilesets to be usable in the editor (or TileD or something) would be the same for MV or MZ.

To be clear - you do not need a plugin to use a tileset. Whether you fit it into a regular tilesheet or use TileD, if you format things correctly you can make it display in game.
If you want to add diagonal movement to go with the angle of the isometric buildings or pixel collision, that's what you start adding the plugins for. But you should be able to get basic map functionality with just the assets.
If you're very new to RPG Maker, you may want to take a little time to do plenty of tutorials and practice making maps with the default assets, learning events, and learn how the default engine works.
Getting too much into modding things before you have a thorough understanding of how things work by default can make you much more confused than you need to be.
